reminder.title: Asked Claude about problems this week yet?
reminder.text: The internet does not scan itself: what is explicitly allowed is not productive enough. Ask Claude for the research in a session instead. You get about ten finds with a link and a summary in its own words, and take over what fits as a signal.
reminder.prompt: Find me publicly discussed annoyances and problems around how co-founders and small teams work together this week. At most ten finds, each with a link, one sentence in your own words on what is annoying, and how sure you are that it is a real, recurring problem. No names, no quotes.
reminder.copyFailed: Copying is not possible, select the text in the field.
reminder.doneText: Done on {date}. From Monday the reminder returns.
